Maya Chen: Quick sync - planning the joint marketplace launch next Friday. Need partner zips, PR author, and landing preview link.
Diego Alvarez: What's the final asset cutoff?
Maya Chen: Cutoff: Wed 23:59 PT for full inclusion. Late partners go to next batch.
Priya Patel: I'll draft the partner checklist: logo SVG+PNG, 2-line blurb, case quote (optional), SI manifest JSON, support contact, target regions.
Diego Alvarez: For SI manifest, lean on this minimal example so ops can auto-ingest:
```
{"partner_id":"acme","type":"si","regions":["us-west-2"],"support":"help@acme.com"}
```
Maya Chen: Staging preview URL will be shared after zips arrive. UTM: utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=partner_launch_{id}.
Priya Patel: Embargo options: Fri 14:00 UTC or Sat 02:00 UTC. Recommend Fri to keep eng support hours sane.
Diego Alvarez: Agree Fri. I'll prepare a small manifest validator and a smoke test for images. ETA Tue evening.
Maya Chen: LaunchBot: schedule dry-run deploy for Thu 09:00 UTC.
LaunchBot: Dry-run scheduled by Maya Chen for 1755634800 (Thu 09:00 UTC).
Priya Patel: Action items: Priya - partner comms + checklist; Diego - validator + ingestion test; Maya - staging preview + final runbook. Everyone - push partners to Wed cutoff.
Diego Alvarez: I'll post validator link here once ready.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Keep escalation to partnerships@redwood-inference.com. End thread.
